Latency, Capex & the 280x Inference Price Drop [M/S · unmetered]

Across 74 Epoch AI sites, plug electricity is 1.5%-11.8% of hourly H100e cost (capex is 8x-70x larger). Dividing the >280x GPT-3.5 price drop by both ~2x hardware trends leaves 70x (~74x; ~141x vs capex).

1/2 Reconciled factor math:
- Two-factor bound: 280 / (2 x 2) = 70x (~74x at 1.98 x 1.90); capex-weighted: 280 / 1.98 = ~141x since power is <12% of USD 0.83-2.50/hr cost
- ~70x-141x came from serving software (vLLM, quantization, distillation), not silicon scaling [M/S]

2/2 FY2025/26 SEC 10-K/10-Q bounds [S]:
- NVIDIA disclosed ecosystem commitments (USD 42B) <= 19.5% of FY26 revenue (USD 215.9B)
- Hyperscalers fund capex at 0.56x-0.94x OCF vs Oracle (1.74x) & CoreWeave (3.37x OCF, 67% MSFT share)
- Unmetered (joules = null)
